  - **Deviation from the ruling's wording:** the ruling said the drill writes its `$gte` as "an equivalent date-family row"; the dev measured that no date-family operator means on-or-after (`after` is strict), so the drill writer is unchanged (`>=` and `before`) and both rows now read as dates, pinned by `drillConditions-36256.test.ts`. ## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `404a3c2f9ce5ececce563e2af4a0d1351a32c954` · 2026-11-24T23:28Z

Requested by zone a4-C (7147329986) for card #37034, against ruling record 7145739965.

Delivered: (1) `conditionDates.ts` formats a condition value by the field's type through core's `formatDate` / `formatDateTime`, with the viewer's locale from `useDisplayLocale()`, on the reader chips, locked view chips and related-field view chips — a date-only value stays its calendar day, a datetime shows in the display zone, a time or unreadable value as written; the month range reads ≥ / before with the year on both bounds; only the display changes, never the payload. (2) zh-CN `showcase_invoice.region` and `showcase_account.sales_region` with their options, keys matching the objects. (3) The two by-design items untouched. No export or key change; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch: right. Check-runs: 45 success, 10 expected skip, 0 failed. K: 11.

**The zone's question — the `$gte` writer: accepted.** No date operator means "on or after": the quick set is between / before / after / is_empty / is_not_empty and `before` / `after` lower to `<` / `>`. Mapping the bound to `after` would drop every record on the first day (date fields) or at exactly midnight (datetime), so the drill list would stop matching the number clicked. The ruling's intent — the bounds read as dates — is met: 「≥ 2026年10月1日」 / 「早于 2026年11月1日」, pinned.

S1 (should-fix) — `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/phone/PhoneListPanels.tsx` ~629 calls the filter row without a locale, so after this PR a zh-CN session on an English browser reads 「Oct 1, 2026」 — new mixed language on a row this PR changed. Pass `useDisplayLocale()` there (the surface widens by that one file; optionally make `locale` required on `ListConditionControls`); pin it.
S2 (should-fix) — the tests pin the wrong case: the card's sighting is a DATETIME field (`created_at`, 「创建时间：≥ 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z」); the server writes ISO instants only for datetime and `YYYY-MM-DD` for a date field. Add a `created_at` datetime `≥` / before case under a pinned display zone (`setDisplayTimeZone('UTC')`) and the real date-only `'2026-10-01'` case; reword `conditionDates.ts`'s comment ("how a day bound is written on the wire") and the PR body's "exact sighting" line.

Q3, coverage baseline: green — `check-i18n-coverage` is a one-sided ratchet; 441 against the 449 ceiling passes. Nit: hand-edit `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json` to 441 in this round (one line; do not run a full `--update`), so the 8 strings of slack close.
Nits: pin the display zone in the "noon UTC, same day in every zone" test (false for UTC+12…+14); a naive `datetime-local` parses in the browser's zone but shows in the display zone — note it in Acceptance notes; the changeset's "every condition row" claim holds once S1 is in.

Delta L1 on the new head.
